decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Site Location Plan;Block Plan ARCHI-LnRd 2502 Dated 07.01.2026;ARCHI-LnRd 2501 Dated 07.01.2026;Existing and Proposed Site Plans ARCHI-PkLe 2509  Dated 07.01.2026;Existing Floor and Roof Plans ARCHI-LnRd 2503 Dated 08.02.2026;Existing Elevation Plans ARCHI-LnRd 2504 Dated 07.01.2026;Proposed Floor Plans ARCHI-LnRd 2505 Dated 07.01.2026;Proposed Elevation Plans ARCHI-LnRd 2506 Dated 07.01.2026;Existing and Proposed Elevation Plans ARCHI-LnRd 2507 Dated 07.01.2026;Proposed ground Floor with Amenity ARCHI-LnRd 2508 Dated 07.01.2026;Design and Access Statement;Fire Safety Statement;Hybrid Parking Survey/Transport Statement;Highway Safety Impact Form;Drainage Strategy Ref: U0763 Rev V1 Date: Dec 25;Flood Risk Assessment Ref: 763 FRA-v1 Date: Dec 25;Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Notwithstanding the approved plans and supporting information, the development hereby permitted shall not be occupied by more than six residents at any one time without first obtaining the approval, in writing, of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To ensure that the future occupation of the building does not adversely affect the adjoining premises/immediate.

No independent cooking or laundry facilities shall be installed in any of the respective bedrooms and the communal kitchen and dining/living rooms shall be retained in perpetuity. Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

Within SIX months from the date of this decision, cycle parking shall be provided on site in compliance with the following criteria:i) Provision of a minimum of SIX long stay cycle parking spacesii) In an accessible location; the access route to each long stay store should be a minimum of 1.2m wide to enable the bike to enter the store, should be step free and involve no more than 2 doors or gates [excluding the store door] which must also have a minimum opening width of 1.2m.iii) Secured with a British Standard mortice lock or access fob.iv) Fully enclosed: 4 walls and a roof.Such facilities to be retained permanently thereafter.Reason: To ensure the provision and availability of adequate cycle parking.

Within SIX months from the date of this decision, details of the design of refuse storage facilities including facilities for the recycling of waste to satisfy the future number of occupiers on site have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Reason: In the interests of amenity and the recycling of waste materials in support of the Boroughs waste reduction targets.

Within SIX months from the date of this decision, details of source control SuDS has been submitted and approved by the Local Authority. Source control SuDS measures include green roofs, rain gardens and permeable paving. The details must include plans, specifications and maintenance information. The developer should use the SuDS Proforma for minor developers found on our webpage https://www.enfield.gov.uk/services/planning/sustainable-drainage-systems to assist them through our requirements.REASON: To ensure the sustainable management of water, minimise flood risk, minimise discharge of surface water outside of the curtilage of the property and ensure that the drainage system will remain functional throughout the lifetime of the development in accordance with Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy, DMD Policy 61, and Policies SI12 & SI13 of the London Plan and the NPPF and to maximise opportunities for sustainable development, improve water quality, biodiversity, local amenity and recreation value.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture as specified in the approved application.  Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.
The second floor side gable window shall be fitted with obscure glazing and shall be retained as such for the duration of the development hereby permitted.Reason: To safeguard residential amenity.
